summary: Full-breadth SEAL sweep for iter 498. Scanned all 260 sidebar menu items in Pro mode + all 14 section hub pages + 5 landing pages + mobile home. Backend GET endpoint sweep across 1056 endpoints from OpenAPI schema. Result: ZERO real backend 500s, ZERO frontend crashes/error-boundaries, ZERO broken panels. Everything renders correctly. A handful of panels are slow-loading (esp. nightly-recap ~10s) but not broken.

minor.issue: Single transient ConnectTimeout during high-fanout sweep (recovered on retry — endpoint works: returns 401 without auth, 200 with).

integration_issues.issue: Takes ~10s to render actual content and shows plain text 'Loading recap…' meanwhile (no skeleton/spinner). Two 401 console errors for benign resources during load — panel still works.

issues: Very low contrast — light white/gray title text on light lavender/purple gradient background is hard to read
Empty state 'Chatbot Automations için lütfen bir otel seçin.' when All Branches is active — legitimate but not obviously actionable (no CTA to open property picker)

action_items: (LOW) Replace 'Loading recap…' text with a skeleton loader for nightly-recap; investigate why initial fetch takes ~10s.
(LOW) Investigate 2 spurious 401 console errors on nightly-recap load — likely a resource fetch missing auth header or hitting a non-existent path.
(LOW) Improve contrast of Nightly Recap header (white text on light lavender gradient).
(NIT) Consider adding property-picker CTA in Chatbot Automations empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has 1956 lines (>>700 threshold) — routers are already split via include_router; server.py itself could still be trimmed of inline model/logic.
App.js has 2784 lines with monolithic activeView switch — huge cognitive load; could be refactored to a route registry / lazy imports keyed by id.

menuSections.js has 8 items whose testId does NOT follow the {id}-btn convention (booking, synclog, reviews, approvals, alerts, api, guide, mapping). Consistent naming would simplify automated testing dramatically.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (260/260 panels + 14/14 hubs + 5/5 landing + mobile all render)

seed_data_creation: None — no test data was created that requires cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 498 was a BREADTH sweep. All 260 sidebar items in Pro mode render — no crashes/empty screens/error boundaries. Backend endpoints across all routers healthy (1056 GETs sampled). Reusable regression: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration498_endpoint_sweep.py. Slow-loading panels needing >2s wait: nightly-recap (~10s), gap-filler (~2s), deposit-automation (~3s), portfolio-board (~3s). When testing panels, always give ≥3s and click dashboard first between clicks to reset state. Sections need localStorage 'nav-open-<Label>'='1' plus 'mhb_nav_mode'='pro' to keep everything expanded. For hub pages, ALL 14 nav-section-<Label> testIds work and render hub grid pages.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional bug found. Slow panels are lazy-fetch behavior (analytics/LLM endpoints). Console 401s on nightly-recap should be investigated but do not block functionality.
